name: What are the common signs of water damage on a door?

mainEntity.name: What are the common signs of water damage on a door?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common signs of water damage on a door include swelling, warping, discoloration, bubbling or peeling paint, and a soft or spongy texture when pressed. You might also notice a musty odor or visible mold growth, especially near the bottom of the door or around the frame. Early detection is important because prolonged water exposure can compromise the door's structural integrity and lead to more extensive damage to the surrounding wall or flooring. When evaluating the damage, consider if the door still closes properly, as warping can prevent a good seal.
